White_potatoes: Any white potatoes or other foods made from roots
Mangoes_or_papayas: Any ripe mango, papaya, melon, watermelon or jackfruit
Dry_fruits: Any dry fruits (raisins, sultanas, dried dates)
Liver_or_organ_meats: Any liver or other organ meats (any chicken-kidney, brain)
Chicken_or_other_meat: Any chicken, animal or other bird meat?
Fish_or_shellfish: Any fresh or dried fish, conch, oyster, crab
Beans_or_lentils: Any food made from beans, peas or lentils
Milk_products: Any cheese, yogurt or other milk products
Oils_or_fats: Any oil, hydrogenated fat, ghee or butter or food made from these
Sugary_foods: Any sweet food - chocolate, sweets, candies, cake, pastry, biscuits
Sweetened_beverages: Any other sweet drinks - soft drinks, commercial juice, etc.
